scope: Source contracts for the first queue control slice. Historical facts, no exact-release operational gate.

no_auth_check.supported_subset: Named/persisted metadata fixture; not proof that a never-materialized live thread is helper-addressable. Add now qualifies addressability with a bounded list(limit1) preflight before final authorization.

observation_limit: A current writer-lock FD alone is not dispatchability. Use canonical connected SessionStart scope + full live foreground fingerprint/boot + matching native-session writer lock, then final canonical and host recheck. A missed SessionEnd combined with retained recorder after failed cleanup can leave stale observed loadedness; the design owner explicitly accepted this limit.
